answer.sql:
WITH international_2016 AS (
  SELECT ury.university_id, ury.score
  FROM university_ranking_year AS ury
  JOIN ranking_criteria AS rc ON rc.id = ury.ranking_criteria_id
  WHERE rc.criteria_name = 'International' AND ury.year = 2016
), counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_universities,
         SUM(CASE WHEN score > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_80
  FROM international_2016
), top_university AS (
  SELECT u.university_name
  FROM international_2016 AS i
  JOIN university AS u ON u.id = i.university_id
  WHERE i.score = (SELECT MAX(score) FROM international_2016 WHERE score > 80)
  ORDER BY u.university_name
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * above_80 / total_universities, 2) AS percent_above_80,
       university_name AS highest_scoring_university
FROM counts CROSS JOIN top_university;

WITH yearly_max AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(pct_international_students) AS max_pct
  FROM university_year
  WHERE pct_international_students IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year
), top AS (
  SELECT uy.university_id, uy.year
  FROM university_year AS uy
  JOIN yearly_max AS ym
    ON ym.year = uy.year
   AND ym.max_pct = uy.pct_international_students
), marked AS (
  SELECT university_id, year,
         year - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY university_id ORDER BY year
         ) AS grp
  FROM top
), streaks AS (
  SELECT university_id, grp
  FROM marked
  GROUP BY university_id, grp
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT u.university_name
FROM streaks AS s
JOIN university AS u ON u.id = s.university_id;
